name: Puzzle Parasite
description:
About This Game

Think with physics.

Explore a strange planet built on logic and reaction. Move, charge, and connect cores to activate mechanisms that reshape the environment, unlocking paths, powering bridges, and revealing the ruins beneath the surface.

Solve together or alone.

Play through a single-player campaign or experience it with a friend. Puzzle Parasite also features a dedicated co-op campaign, built around communication, timing, and shared problem-solving.

Built with care

Every level is built with intention. A focused, curated experience where every puzzle is designed to challenge your logic and reward curiosity.

Key Features

  • A cozy yet thrilling first-person puzzle adventure along with calm and satisfying sound effects and music.

  • First person room based puzzle challenges where every level is intentionally designed: no filler, no repetition, players figure out the mystery at their own pace.

  • Core actions specifically hand crafted to make them feel smooth & satisfying every time you use it.

  • An engaging core mechanic focused on physics, logic, observation, and satisfying chain-reaction problem-solving.
short_desc: Puzzle Parasite is a sci-fi puzzle adventure where you wield telekinetic powers and a cricket bat. You send energy cores flying, power alien tech, and avoid deadly lasers, as you go deeper to uncover the hidden secrets. A handcrafted tribute to the classics that made us think in new ways.
